  • Constructor Details

    • Input

      public Input(StandardEdition edition, String equipmentType, double gravityCutDiameter, Api12JSeparatorDesignKernel.DiameterUnit diameterUnit, double kFactorMPerS, boolean mistEliminatorPresent, double liquidResidenceTimeS, Api12JSeparatorDesignKernel.Orientation orientation, boolean threePhase)
      Create an API 12J screening input.
      Parameters:
      edition - explicit API 12J edition
      equipmentType - simple separator equipment class name
      gravityCutDiameter - gravity-section cut diameter
      diameterUnit - unit of gravityCutDiameter
      kFactorMPerS - operating Souders-Brown K-factor in m/s
      mistEliminatorPresent - whether a mist eliminator is installed
      liquidResidenceTimeS - liquid residence time in seconds
      orientation - separator orientation
      threePhase - whether the separator handles gas, oil, and water
